title: Roasted Garlic and Wild Mushroom Polish
description: A hearty and savory polish dish featuring roasted garlic and wild mushrooms. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Peel the garlic and slice the wild mushrooms.
In a baking dish, combine the sliced wild mushrooms, roasted garlic, and chopped fresh leaves.
Drizzle with dry white wine and toss to coat.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Note: Cooking time may vary depending on the size of the mushrooms and garlic.
